title: Hyperspace Jump (hard)
statementMd:
It is now 125 years later, but humanity is still on the run from a humanoid-cyborg race determined to destroy it. Or perhaps we are getting some stories mixed up here... In any case, the fleet is now smaller. However, in a recent upgrade, all the navigation systems have been outfitted with higher-dimensional, linear-algebraic jump processors.

Now, in order to make a jump, a ship's captain needs to specify a *subspace* of the $*d*$-dimensional space in which the events are taking place. She does so by providing a generating set of vectors for that subspace.

Princess Heidi has received such a set from the captain of each of $*m*$ ships. Again, she would like to group up those ships whose hyperspace jump subspaces are equal. To do so, she wants to assign a group number between $1$ and $*m*$ to each of the ships, so that two ships have the same group number if and only if their corresponding subspaces are equal (even though they might be given using different sets of vectors).

Help Heidi!

## Input

The first line of the input contains two space-separated integers $*m*$ and $*d*$ ($2 ≤ *m* ≤ 30 000$, $1 ≤ *d* ≤ 5$) – the number of ships and the dimension of the full underlying vector space, respectively. Next, the $*m*$ subspaces are described, one after another. The $*i*$-th subspace, which corresponds to the $*i*$-th ship, is described as follows:

The first line contains one integer $*k*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *k*_{*i*} ≤ *d*$). Then $*k*_{*i*}$ lines follow, the $*j*$-th of them describing the $*j*$-th vector sent by the $*i*$-th ship. Each of the $*j*$ lines consists of $*d*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{*j*}$, $*j* = 1, ..., *d*$, that describe the vector ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ab929a3e14032f5003e6f023f92be72813548b37.png); it holds that $|*a*_{*j*}| ≤ 250$. The $*i*$-th subspace is the linear span of these $*k*_{*i*}$ vectors.

## Output

Output $*m*$ space-separated integers $*g*_{1}, ..., *g*_{*m*}$, where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3eb37f80bcb83d8830fb0aa4d1327b5783fc2ff8.png) denotes the group number assigned to the $*i*$-th ship. That is, for any $1 ≤ *i* < *j* ≤ *m*$, the following should hold: $*g*_{*i*} = *g*_{*j*}$ if and only if the $*i*$-th and the $*j*$-th subspaces are equal. In addition, the sequence $(*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*m*})$ should be lexicographically minimal among all sequences with that property.

## Note

In the sample testcase, the first and the last subspace are equal, subspaces 2 to 4 are equal, and subspaces 5 to 7 are equal.

Recall that two subspaces, one given as the span of vectors ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8dc56705315ce4b334dd46dbc9c8c51fffb0036.png) and another given as the span of vectors ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99fd3b5233ff3b6f4989df43e2f60edb184bee11.png), are equal if each vector $*v*_{*i*}$ can be written as a linear combination of vectors $*w*_{1}, ..., *w*_{*k*}$ (that is, there exist coefficients ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ae69b90a53c26d24b0b4a40a6970f6d5903cd568.png) such that $*v*_{*i*} = α_{1}*w*_{1} + ... + α_{*k*}*w*_{*k*}$) and, similarly, each vector $*w*_{*i*}$ can be written as a linear combination of vectors $*v*_{1}, ..., *v*_{*n*}$.

Recall that a sequence $(*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*m*})$ is lexicographically smaller than a sequence $(*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*m*})$ if there exists an index $*i*$, $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$, such that $*g*_{*i*} < *h*_{*i*}$ and $*g*_{*j*} = *h*_{*j*}$ for all $*j* < *i*$.
statementZhMd:
现在已经过去了 125 年，但人类仍在躲避一个决心将其毁灭的人形半机械人种族。或者，也许我们把某些故事混在一起了……无论如何，如今舰队的规模已经缩小。不过，在最近的一次升级中，所有导航系统都配备了更高维度的线性代数跳跃处理器。

现在，为了进行一次跳跃，舰长需要指定发生事件的 $*d*$ 维空间中的一个*子空间*。她需要提供该子空间的一组生成向量。

海蒂公主从 $*m*$ 艘飞船的舰长那里分别收到了这样一组向量。同样，她希望将超空间跳跃子空间相等的飞船分到同一组。为此，她想要为每艘飞船分配一个介于 $1$ 和 $*m*$ 之间的组编号，使得两艘飞船拥有相同的组编号，当且仅当它们对应的子空间相等（即使这些子空间可能由不同的向量集合给出）。

请帮助海蒂！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*m*$ 和 $*d*$（$2 ≤ *m* ≤ 30 000$，$1 ≤ *d* ≤ 5$），分别表示飞船数量和底层完整向量空间的维数。接下来依次描述 $*m*$ 个子空间。对应于第 $*i*$ 艘飞船的第 $*i*$ 个子空间描述如下：

第一行包含一个整数 $*k*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *k*_{*i*} ≤ *d*$）。接下来有 $*k*_{*i*}$ 行，其中第 $*j*$ 行描述第 $*i*$ 艘飞船发送的第 $*j*$ 个向量。每个这样的行包含 $*d*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*j}$，$*j* = 1, ..., *d*$，用于描述向量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ab929a3e14032f5003e6f023f92be72813548b37.png)；满足 $|*a*_{*j}| ≤ 250$。第 $*i*$ 个子空间是这 $*k*_{*i*}$ 个向量的线性张成空间。

## 输出格式

输出 $*m*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*g*_{1}, ..., *g*_{*m*}$，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3eb37f80bcb83d8830fb0aa4d1327b5783fc2ff8.png) 表示分配给第 $*i*$ 艘飞船的组编号。也就是说，对于任意 $1 ≤ *i* < *j* ≤ *m*$，都应满足：当且仅当第 $*i*$ 个和第 $*j*$ 个子空间相等时，$*g*_{*i*} = *g*_{*j}$。此外，序列 $(*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*m*})$ 应当在所有满足该性质的序列中按字典序最小。

## 说明

在样例测试中，第一个和最后一个子空间相等，子空间 2 至 4 相等，子空间 5 至 7 相等。

回忆一下，一个由向量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8dc56705315ce4b334dd46dbc9c8c51fffb0036.png) 的张成空间给出的子空间，与另一个由向量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99fd3b5233ff3b6f4989df43e2f60edb184bee11.png) 的张成空间给出的子空间相等，当且仅当每个向量 $*v*_{*i*}$ 都可以表示为向量 $*w*_{1}, ..., *w*_{*k*}$ 的线性组合（也就是说，存在系数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ae69b90a53c26d24b0b4a40a6970f6d5903cd568.png)，使得 $*v*_{*i*} = α_{1}*w*_{1} + ... + α_{*k*}*w*_{*k*}$），并且每个向量 $*w*_{*i*}$ 也都可以表示为向量 $*v*_{1}, ..., *v*_{*n*}$ 的线性组合。

回忆一下，如果存在一个下标 $*i*$，$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$，使得 $*g*_{*i*} < *h*_{*i*}$，并且对于所有 $*j* < *i*$ 都有 $*g*_{*j*} = *h*_{*j*}$，则称序列 $(*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*m*})$ 按字典序小于序列 $(*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*m*})$。
